tagline: This serverless compute release includes updates from Databricks Runtime 19.
what_it_does: This serverless compute release includes updates from Databricks Runtime 19. Behavior changes Spark Connect execution metrics hide row filter and column mask details: DataFrame execution metrics now hide internal operators and metrics associated with row filters and column masks. This protects information about policy execution when you inspect df.executionInfo.metrics, including its text representation.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
